title: Use a single prompt with Seedance 2.5 to generate a full video without editing…
content:
Use a single prompt with Seedance 2.5 to generate a full video without editing (e.g., 30 seconds from a long ~10k-word prompt).  
Use image referencing (e.g., a Pepsi image) in Seedance 2.5 to guide the video’s visuals.
